description: This is a PHP class implementing data access methods for managing subscription records within an OpenCart project. It provides functions for retrieving subscription details, lists, counts, and related data such as histories, products, options, and addresses.

classes.name: Subscription
classes.description: Model class for managing subscription data in the 'account' namespace, extending the core engine model, providing methods to retrieve, count, and list subscriptions, their associated products, options, histories, and addressing details.

methods.name: getSubscription
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific subscription by its ID, returning fields such as payment and shipping methods.

methods.name: getSubscriptions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of subscriptions for the current customer, with support for pagination.

methods.name: getTotalSubscriptions
methods.description: Returns the total count of subscriptions for the current customer.

methods.name: getTotalSubscriptionByShippingAddressId
methods.description: Counts subscriptions associated with a specific shipping address ID.

methods.name: getTotalSubscriptionByPaymentAddressId
methods.description: Counts subscriptions associated with a specific payment address ID.

methods.name: getProductByOrderProductId
methods.description: Fetches subscription data related to a specific order and product combination.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Lists all products associated with a particular subscription.

methods.name: getTotalProducts
methods.description: Counts the number of products within a specific subscription.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Retrieves options associated with a given subscription and subscription product.

methods.name: getHistories
methods.description: Lists historical status updates and comments for a subscription with pagination.

methods.name: getTotalHistories
methods.description: Counts total history records for a specific subscription.
